item.title: "The majority of the attacks allow recovery of passwords" — New research suggests your favorite password manager might not be as secure as you thought
item.description: A new paper posits that major password managers are vulnerable to several different types of attack, with results as severe as complete vault takeovers. Here's what you need to know.

item.title: Xbox Ally X pricing is up AGAIN — is your region affected?
item.description: The ROG Xbox Ally X just received another regional price hike, now in Australia. The increase raises questions about rising handheld costs and hardware pricing.

item.title: WWE 2K26 is spilling the beans on its take on MyRise — and its new scenarios, mechanics, and rewards continue to make it my favorite WWE 2K game mode
item.description: WWE and 2K have released a new Ringside Report on WWE 2K26's MyRise story mode with a trailer narrated by Paul Heyman. It will include branching paths, tons of unlockable rewards, new scenarios, and more.

item.title: We’re not the only ones saying it: Windows 11 desperately needs a single privacy toggle
item.description: Windows 11 makes privacy confusing. Settings are fragmented, telemetry stays active, and it's time for Microsoft to add a master switch.

item.title: As Season 2 launches, Battlefield 6 devs say they've "heard the message very clear" about the desire for big maps — but "it takes a really long time" to make them
item.description: As Season 2 starts, Battlefield 6 devs say they've "heard the message very clear" regarding players wanting bigger maps, but they're not coming quickly.

item.title: Is it time to leave Discord? We asked Windows Central readers as the platform faces severe backlash over age verification — and ties to Peter Thiel
item.description: We asked you if Discord's latest decisions have crossed a red line, and the answer is clear.

item.title: Avowed dev Obsidian didn't expect everyone to hate one of the Xbox RPG's biggest systems — "That frustration came through loud and clear"
item.description: Crafting upgrades was very important in Xbox's Avowed, and many players hated that. Developer Obsidian, notably, was very "surprised" by the feedback.

item.title: The "practically perfect" Razer Kishi Ultra just dropped to its lowest price ever — a premium mobile controller finally priced for everyone
item.description: Razer’s premium Kishi Ultra controller is now at its lowest price ever, making its robust build and haptics far more accessible to mobile gamers.

item.title: Our all-time favorite Xbox gaming headset with "immaculate sound and a cavernous soundscape" is on a 25% discount — and it's got a monstrous battery
item.description: The Turtle Beach Stealth 700 (Gen 3), a fantastic gaming headset for Xbox that we gave a perfect 5-Star rating to, has received a sizeable 25% price cut to give players a chance to enhance their auditory gaming experiences for less.

item.title: Battlefield 6 Season 2's new Contaminated map is rad, and so is the Little Bird — I wanted more content, but what's here is fantastic
item.description: Battlefield 6 Season 2 is here, and though its not bringing a ton of content, its new Contaminated map and Little Bird helicopter are awesome.
